title: Aligning Large Multimodal Models with Factually Augmented RLHF
best_for_zh: 偏好学习、奖励建模与反馈审计研究者
one_line: Aligning Large Multimodal Models with Factually Augmented RLHF releases image-text conversations with human preferences over answers and factually augmented reward-learning context for preference learning, reward modeling, evaluation, and feedback audit.
图文问答的人类偏好比较结合图像事实信息，可用于降低多模态奖励模型的幻觉。

title: Problem
问题
html:
Vision-language assistants can give fluent answers that are not supported by the image. This paper studies that hallucination boundary in image-grounded dialogue: a response is preferred when it is less hallucinated, and, when both are grounded, more helpful.

The decision surface is an image, conversation context, and two candidate responses. LLaVA-RLHF turns that comparison into reward-model supervision and evaluates whether the resulting assistant reduces hallucination on open-ended image questions.

视觉语言助手可以给出流畅却不受图像支持的回答。本文聚焦图文对话中的这类幻觉边界：两答比较时优先选择幻觉更少者；若两者均与图像相符，再比较帮助性。

其判定对象是图像、对话上下文和两个候选回答。LLaVA-RLHF 将该比较转为奖励模型监督，并检验所得助手能否在开放式图像问题上减少幻觉。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: LLaVA-RLHF combines 10,000 crowdworker comparisons of held-out image conversations with Fact-RLHF: the reward model receives factual context—five COCO captions or A-OKVQA rationales/options—alongside the image, prompt, and response. The feedback contract records a relative human choice centered on grounding and helpfulness; factual context calibrates the learned score but does not replace that preference label or establish universal visual truth.
LLaVA-RLHF 将一万条保留图文对话的众包比较，与 Fact-RLHF 结合：奖励模型除接收图像、提问和回答外，还接收五条 COCO 图注或 A-OKVQA 理由与选项等事实上下文。反馈契约是以图像一致性和帮助性为中心的相对人工选择；事实上下文用于校准学习到的分数，不替代偏好标签，也不构成普适的视觉真相。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Fine-tune a LLaVA-based assistant, then resample held-out conversations to obtain response pairs for crowd comparison. 2. Train a pairwise reward model to score the chosen response higher, using the image and conversation. 3. Supply captions, rationales, or answer options to the same reward model, and add correctness and length penalties where the task exposes an answer. 4. Optimize the policy with PPO and a KL penalty on 50,000 held-out conversations plus VQA-v2 and A-OKVQA questions.

The output is a policy and an augmented reward model; acceptance is measured by LLaVA-Bench, MMHal-Bench, MMBench, and POPE. Reproduction requires the released model/data/code and the factual side information available at training and scoring time.

1. 先微调基于 LLaVA 的助手，再对保留对话重新采样，得到供众包比较的回答对。2. 用图像和对话训练成对奖励模型，使其给被选回答更高分。3. 向同一奖励模型提供图注、理由或答案选项，并在有标准答案的任务中加入正确性和长度惩罚。4. 在五万条保留对话及 VQA-v2、A-OKVQA 问题上，以 PPO 和 KL 惩罚优化策略。

产物是策略与增强奖励模型；验收使用 LLaVA-Bench、MMHal-Bench、MMBench 和 POPE。复现需使用已发布的模型、数据和代码，并在训练与打分时取得相同的事实辅助信息。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Claim: factual augmentation makes multimodal RLHF more resistant to hallucination-driven reward hacking. Under the paper's LLaVA comparison, the RLHF model reaches 94% of text-only GPT-4 on LLaVA-Bench and the authors report a 60% improvement over other baselines on MMHal-Bench; their GPT-4-based MMHal judge agrees with human judgments on 94% of the checked cases. These are reported benchmark results, not proof that captions prevent hallucination outside the supplied factual contexts.
主张：事实增强能使多模态 RLHF 更不易因幻觉获得虚高奖励。在论文的 LLaVA 对照中，RLHF 模型在 LLaVA-Bench 达到文本版 GPT-4 的 94%，作者报告其在 MMHal-Bench 上较其他基线提升 60%；该基准所用的 GPT-4 判定器在抽查中与人工判断一致率为 94%。这些是给定事实上下文和基准下的报告结果，并不证明图注能在其他场景杜绝幻觉。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Standard multimodal RLHF asks a reward model to infer grounding from image, prompt, and response alone. Fact-RLHF keeps pairwise preference learning but exposes verified textual image information to the scorer at both training and inference. The direction signal is that an external factual channel can constrain reward optimization; the paper does not introduce a new preference loss or show that all factual sources are reliable.
常规多模态 RLHF 只让奖励模型根据图像、提问和回答判断是否贴合图像。Fact-RLHF 保留成对偏好学习，却在训练和推断时向评分器提供已知的图像文字事实。它提示外部事实通道可约束奖励优化；论文没有提出新的偏好损失，也未证明所有事实来源都可靠。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Author-stated: the single reward model jointly represents honesty and helpfulness; the paper leaves a separate honesty reward for future work. Consequently, a high score can still hide a trade-off between being useful and being grounded; audit those dimensions separately.

Curator risk: Fact-RLHF depends on captions, rationales, or answer options being available and correct. Its reported anti-hallucination gain should therefore not be transferred to ordinary images without equivalent factual context.

作者指出：单一奖励模型同时表示诚实性与帮助性，独立的诚实性奖励仍留待后续研究。因此，高分仍可能掩盖“有用”与“贴合图像”之间的取舍，应分别审计这两个维度。

策展风险：Fact-RLHF 依赖图注、理由或答案选项可得且正确。因而其报告的抗幻觉收益不应直接外推到没有等价事实上下文的普通图像。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this card when training or auditing a vision-language reward model for image-grounded answers. Feed the scorer an image, dialogue, two responses, and only documented factual side information; inspect whether its chosen answer is both less hallucinated and useful. Do not use the release as a general factuality label set when the deployment task lacks captions, rationales, or answer options.
适用于训练或审计面向图像一致性回答的视觉语言奖励模型。向评分器输入图像、对话、两个回答以及有出处的事实辅助信息，并检查其所选回答是否既少幻觉又有帮助。若部署任务没有图注、理由或答案选项，不应把该发布当作通用事实性标签集使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. The label compares two image-dialogue responses, prioritizing fewer hallucinations.
  2. The paper collects 10,000 such human preferences from held-out LLaVA data.
  3. Fact-RLHF adds captions, rationales, or options to the reward-model input.
  4. PPO uses 50,000 held-out conversations plus task questions.
  5. The reported 60% MMHal-Bench gain is benchmark- and context-bound.

1. 标签比较两个图文对话回答，优先幻觉更少者。
  2. 论文从保留的 LLaVA 数据收集了一万条人工偏好。
  3. Fact-RLHF 向奖励模型输入加入图注、理由或选项。
  4. PPO 使用五万条保留对话及任务问题。
  5. MMHal-Bench 的 60% 提升受基准和事实上下文限制。
